items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: INTERVIEWER: You remember when that girl came around to see you? Her name was Irish Turner Kelso in the hospital.

ctx.x: Tell you all by and by. But you got to fly, fly, fly, fly. Every little one got to fly high. Fly, fly, fly high. Before mother die. It was well as winter when time was rough. I was in the weather strutting my stuff. So fly, fly, fly, fly. Every little one got to fly high.

I knew she'd get a kick out of that. You remember when that girl came around to see you? Her name was Irish Turner Kelso in the hospital. We got a nice interview and you sang that song. She's from Mississippi. Her cousin was editor of the New York Times. That's what I'm trying to say. You see her on the TV now. Them guys late too. That's her. She's the one who called you.
No, I ain't talking about them three guys. Three guys? Yeah. They must be at three o'clock. But I mean, they'll be all right.
